title: D-NOVA: In-Storage Retrieval Accelerator via Dual-Bound 3D NAND-Optimized Similarity Search with Vector Adaptation
selection_reason: RAG inferenceのvector retrievalをNAND array内部へ押し込み、Dual-Bound Tight Similarity Sensingとcontrastive adapterを協調設計するin-storage accelerator。CPU比最大41.7x高速・71x高energy efficiency、既存in-storage RAG accelerator比12.13x throughputを報告し、storage-side inference pipelineの隣接系統として価値が高い。
